description: This is an HTML file implementing the front-end interface for a database visualizer. It includes styling, structure, and embedded JavaScript for dynamically loading and interacting with database and table data, as well as rendering tables and handling user interactions.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list and resets UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles expanding/collapsing database entries and loads their tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the data into an HTML table with features for large content.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual table cells, handling nulls, objects, and wide text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for wide or object data.
